author: aagrant99
body: Hello I am aagrant99 and I am looking for a team.  I have been here since the mczone days when I played skywars, the walls, and mostly nebula.  I was inactive for 2 years but have come back.  I believe since I came back I have restored much of my former abilities.  I consider myself to be excellent with a bow and relatively decent in melee combat.  I have no infractions to my name and would cause no trouble for the owner of a scrimmage team that would be responsible for the actions of everyone in their team in a scrimmage.  I am not the most active and am an extremely busy person, but when I am here I do well and do keep good relations in general with the avicus community.  I rarely go offensive and do not really have monuments to my name but can prove to be a formidable defensive player with extreme dedication to that goal. I am willing to toss away lives if it furthers my goals of achieving that.  I have a pretty decent Kdr. In excess of 1.4 though that is not too far above average:  I hope you look into me as a potential player in your team.  I have no set team in particular that I have ambitions to join but I will look into some of the choices brought upon me (assuming they are).  I hope you enjoyed this post and have a great day.
